column1: # Airline codes (ADR-044, Add route): the ICAO code a flight's callsign
# starts with, and the IATA code its flight number is sold with, so that
# callsign ACA856 is flight AC856. Hand-made from the airlines' own codes
# (facts, no licence); an airline not here keeps its callsign.
# ICAO<TAB>IATA<TAB>Name (as in airlines.tsv; for Flightradar24's operator code)
